candidates.statement: Order service checkout returns HTTP 500: order traces show ERROR status with 1650ms duration, order logs record 11 unhandled_request_failure ERROR events at status 500, and order error_rate is 0.24 with p95 520ms, while gateway stays healthy (error_rate 0.0014, p95 72ms, status 200).
candidates.uncertainty: Underlying trigger of the order 500s (code defect vs dependency) is not established; inventory and payment metrics are healthy, but order-internal error detail is absent.

report.explanation: Order service is the degraded component: its traces error, logs show 11 unhandled 500 failures, and error_rate/p95 are elevated, while gateway, inventory and payment remain healthy. Deployment records alone do not establish causation. Root cause is bounded to order-side HTTP 500 failures; the specific internal defect is not yet evidenced.
